reason: E3/E4 directly confirm nanoscaled L12 precipitate formation at 800 °C in the same alloy, achieving ~1200 MPa UTS and ~20% elongation, supporting all key premises. E1 provides additional evidence of a minimal ductility loss (39% to 36%) with nanoscale precipitates, though in a slightly different processing route. E2 is less directly relevant but does not contradict the premises.
premises: L12-(Ni,Co)3Ti precipitates form in CoCrFeNiTi0.2 upon aging at 800 °C
Ductility is retained or only marginally reduced after precipitation
